descriptionHtml:
Bug B29 · P2 · known

Nursing Home residents have no Facility field: it cannot be entered, is not shown and cannot be searched

Tickets: TFA-92581 AC3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-03/S10

Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S11 Add Resident form asks for the Nursing Home identity fields

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Nursing Home identity fields are name, unit/room, MRN and facility. (UAT TC-03)
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Standard fixture, Nursing Home context

When Open the Add Resident form (the + button on the Nursing Home list, or /snf/add) and look at it without saving

Then The form asks for name, unit/room and MRN, and for facility if facility is meant to be typed on add (Q1)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 mustContain 'Full Name', 'Unit', 'MRN' (U6) and 'Facility'. 'Facility' is listed under knownGaps: it is judged only if Q1 says facility is typed on add; otherwise the item is dropped, and AC 3's facility Fail rests on S10. The form's full field list in the snapshot is recorded for Q2 (complete set vs minimum), not judged. …

Where it ran: dev unit U24; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92581 ready for qa

The Nursing Home Add Resident form asks for name, date of birth, unit/room and MRN, but has no Facility field.

Evidence: dev U24 (ledger #24, re-judged Fail (known)). Already in dev report §4. It counts only if Q1 answers 'typed on add'; S10 carries the AC 3 facility Fail. Same root as TC-03/S10.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
